name: Hiiragi Asahi
source:
The protagonist's older sister. She is a student at a university of arts and is majoring in design. After both of their parents died, she started doing housework and took care of the protagonist as a substitute parent. The protagonist was worried about being a burden to her so he moved to the Hisekisou apartment complex, but she actually has a brother complex so she is hoping that he will return.

[Based on [url=http://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/初恋サクラメント]Wikipedia[/url]]
